'''March 2001 Toledo tournament (18 March)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Toledo, Ohio on 18 March 2001. [[Brad Eier]] won it. It is known from Brad Eier's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1918">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-19-toledo-oh-3-18-00-bring-in-the-bacond1918/ toledo-oh-3-18-00-bring-in-the-bacon], DeckTech (brad "swccguy" eier, 19 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-19-toledo-oh-3-18-00-bring-in-the-bacond1918/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 18 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Toledo, Ohio
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Brad Eier]]
